_comment: ADR-0562 §10.26 move-22 sub-batch (a): home the `intelligence` capability's FIRST slice — the sixteen cloud-intelligence crates — and ESTABLISH the intelligence/ capability root + its closed-registry/membership/acyclicity contracts. intelligence is the FINAL + LARGEST capability (AI/intelligence substrate: SDK adapters, the OAuth subscription-pool request pipeline + proof layer, agentic capabilities). It is decomposed into ~7 serial sub-batch PRs; THIS sub-batch homes ONLY cloud/cloud-intelligence/crates/* (16 crates from ONE source dir) into intelligence/{core 4, adapters 10, facade 2} (ports is established by the root contract but receives crates in later sub-batches). The remaining 126 oya/intelligence crates (+ oya/detection) follow in sub-batches b-g; the capability-registry entry already maps oya/intelligence + oya/detection via absorbs_current_dirs, so the PARTIAL state stays membership-consistent (those crates remain mapped to `intelligence` while physically under oya/intelligence). FACE DECISIONS verified by ENUMERATION of every intra-capability path-dep (the acyclicity gate is structurally BLIND to intelligence/* edges — owning_service() only recognizes cloud/+oya/): the four kernels (kernel = OAuth seat-pool state machine + AuthzGate seam; tool-compat-kernel; translation-kernel; wire-kernel) are pure-serde leaves => core; the authz-cedar / codex / gemini / openbao / eventsink-clickhouse / eventsink-valkey transient provider+infra impls, the claude-agent-sdk + codex-sdk vendor SDK transports, and ops-infrastructure are adapters; the rest crate (axum reverse-proxy router + concrete codex-adapter + gemini-adapter deps) is ADAPTERS — the suggested ports/ placement is a FACE INVERSION: rest depends on TWO concrete adapters (codex-adapter, gemini-adapter) so it cannot be core/ports, and it is depended on by openbao-adapter (an adapter, which impls rest's SecretProviderStore trait) so it cannot be facade; adapters is the unique legal whole-crate face (the cleaner SecretProviderStore->ports trait extraction is a REFACTOR, out of scope for a placement-only move, captured for a follow-up IP); the app composition-root (the cloud-intelligence binary; wires kernel + rest + 4 adapters via build_app()->Arc<AppState> + axum::serve) and the worker (zero intra deps) are facade — the only non-downward edge is the legitimate app(facade)->{core,rest+4 adapters}. ZERO core/ports->adapters edges (enumeration pasted in the PR body). cargo == de-branded path-tail `intelligence-<leaf>` (drop the oya- vendor prefix, de-dup the cloud-intelligence path-doubling, face dir NOT in the name; the leaf discriminator is retained because dropping it would collide e.g. intelligence-eventsink-clickhouse-adapter). CUSTOM-BIN (#76): the app crate's [[bin]] name `cloud-intelligence` is RUNTIME-COUPLED (cloud/cloud-intelligence/Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT /usr/local/bin/cloud-intelligence + cloud/cloud-intelligence/k8s/cloud-intelligence.yaml workload image) => LEFT verbatim, noted for phase-2 (iam precedent only de-brands non-runtime-coupled bins); the codemod leaves it because the bin name differs from the package snake ident so the [[bin]].name snake-mirror never fires. artifacts co-move the 5 promotion-gating SLOs into intelligence/observability/slos/ (single source dir => no per-service subdir collision, flat per ADR-0139) and re-key the 8 pre-existing registry/catalog records oya-cloud-intelligence-* -> intelligence-* (8 of the 16 moved crates carry a gate-bound catalog record; the other 8 carry none — catalog-liveness backstop). justification_ref: ADR-0562 §10.26(a); reachability seed: intelligence/OWNERS (specs/reachability-registry.json §10.26a). The absorbed dir's other non-crate artifacts (cloud-intelligence manifest.json/docs/PRD/IPs/contracts/iac/k8s/policy/Dockerfile) are homed in phase-2 (task #62), per the §10.5..§10.25 precedent. The dev-cli supply-chain HOME (validate_crate_id, catalog-domain) lives in oya/intelligence — NOT this sub-batch — but the de-branded intelligence-* ids reach the supply-chain/score-card validators; verified no de-branded id trips a validator (#750 sensitivity). VIOLATION-SOURCE: none — every cloud-intelligence outbound edge stays within the capability or points DOWN to libs/oya-shared-olap-*; zero NEW acyclicity/total-accounting violations (rename-aware engine, ADR-0563).
